tokentrim cost savings estimate

tokentrim is a free, open‑source toolkit that trims Claude Code output and manages token usage. On the site you can see how much you can save by installing it and running the cost‑savings estimate.

How to get a savings estimate for your own conversations

  1. Install tokentrim as a plugin or clone the repo.
  2. Run the replay command on a conversation you’ve had with Claude.
  3. The dashboard shows the number of tokens that would have been read, the compaction window used, and the resulting cost reduction.
  4. Compare the “before” and “after” numbers to see the exact savings.

What you get and the costs

  • All hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold‑cache alert are free.
  • Pro lifetime: $49 (first 500 buyers).
  • Pro monthly: $9/month.
  • Pro adds a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, weekly budget alert at 80%, Slack totals, and support for up to 3 machines.
  • Nothing leaves your machine by default.

FAQ

Question? How much can I save with the free version? Answer: In 135 real conversations, the free version cut history re‑read by 75%, made limits last 4.0x longer, and reduced billed cost by roughly 55‑70%.

Question? Do I need a paid plan to see savings? Answer: No. The free toolkit includes all hooks and the replay command that shows your own numbers.

Question? What if I want a team dashboard? Answer: A shared team dashboard is in the works; a paid team audit is available on request.
